basis: renders a native <nav aria-label> over <ul>/<li> of <a> items with aria-current="page" — the navigation landmark is the contract.

responsive.basis: a nav list — collapsing it into a rail is the host's decision (the collapsed prop), not a viewport behaviour of the pattern's own; at any fixed width its geometry is content-driven.

exceptions.because: e2e/focus-not-obscured.e2e.ts (WCAG 2.4.11) covers three pages today — button, dialog, drawer; this page joins when that suite's population grows (tracked in ecoma-io/loom#272)
